mentions.name: Etymon
mentions.description: A daily etymology puzzle in which players use six clues, including a cognate clue giving two words that share a root with the hidden word, to reveal a hidden word. It is free to play Monday through Friday with no email required, while weekends and the puzzle archive are gated.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on Etymon, a daily etymology puzzle. Each puzzle has six clues to help reveal a hidden word. The cognate clue (4) gives two words that share the same root with the hidden word.
